Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect reduce an opponent's Digimon's DP even if I didn't play a card with it?

Card Q&A.a: No, it is not immediately deleted at this point in time.All activated effects are resolved, after which a rule check occurs. At that point in time, all Digimon with 0 DP are deleted simultaneously.
Card Q&A.q: All of my Digimon are currently getting -5000 DP, and I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to play a Digimon with 5000 DP or less.At such times, is the played Digimon deleted before the part of the effect that follows after "Then" is processed?

Card Q&A.a:
No, you can't.[BT24-041 Minervamon]'s first effect triggers when it's played, and the effect also reduces the cost paid but doesn't reduce the actual cost. Therefore, [BT24-041 Minervamon] can't be played with this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect.
